name: tempoc
description: Shows how far you are through Claude's usage windows: amount used vs. time elapsed, above the prompt

hour5_color_enabled.title: 5-hour: color the bar
hour5_color_enabled.description: Turn the 5-hour bar Warning or Danger color when usage runs ahead of elapsed time

hour5_warning.title: 5-hour: Warning at
hour5_warning.description: Points by which 5-hour usage must exceed elapsed time to turn Warning color

hour5_danger.title: 5-hour: Danger at
hour5_danger.description: Points by which 5-hour usage must exceed elapsed time to turn Danger color

day7_color_enabled.title: 7-day: color the bar
day7_color_enabled.description: Turn the 7-day bar Warning or Danger color when usage runs ahead of elapsed time

day7_warning.title: 7-day: Warning at
day7_warning.description: Points by which 7-day usage must exceed elapsed time to turn Warning color

day7_danger.title: 7-day: Danger at
day7_danger.description: Points by which 7-day usage must exceed elapsed time to turn Danger color

utilization_warning.title: Warning at usage
utilization_warning.description: Usage percent that turns any bar Warning color, whatever the elapsed time

utilization_danger.title: Danger at usage
utilization_danger.description: Usage percent that turns any bar Danger color, whatever the elapsed time
